workingTitle: Cross-model structural uncertainty and gross HMA consequences under a specified overlay rule

identity.contributionStatement: Quantify cross-model structural discrepancies and their decision consequences without treating any engineering model as field truth.

components.purpose: Compare model structure and decision rankings on compatible declared operations.
Translate model discrepancies through an explicit overlay rule.
Calculate gross installed HMA for one modeled overlay event.
Use LTPP only for maintenance intervals, overlay thickness, and density context.

modelStructures.label: Mechanistic fatigue model
modelStructures.equationSet: Published bottom-up fatigue transfer functions and response equations frozen in the implementation artifact.
modelStructures.coefficientSet: Published coefficient table frozen without outcome-driven recalibration.
modelStructures.baselineSelectionJustification: This mechanistic structure is the prespecified candidate because it exposes the pavement response pathway under the same frozen inputs.

modelStructures.label: Reference fatigue model
modelStructures.equationSet: Published reference fatigue equations independently encoded and frozen before outcome inspection.
modelStructures.coefficientSet: Published reference coefficient table with no candidate-specific tuning.
modelStructures.baselineSelectionJustification: The reference is the strongest independently published model that exposes a compatible fatigue endpoint and can be run on identical inputs without field-truth claims.

targetJournals.fallback: Journal of Transportation Engineering, Part B

estimands.population: Declared pavement structures and heavy-vehicle configurations
estimands.outcome: cross-model fatigue-damage discrepancy and decision disagreement

claims.statement: Engineering model structures differ in response ranking and modeled overlay decisions on the declared cases.
claims.nullOutcomeStatement: The frozen model structures may agree within the declared decision tolerance.

claims.statement: Under the specified overlay rule, a modeled additional event implies a gross installed HMA mixture requirement per lane-kilometre.

edges.operatorDefinition: For each model, configuration, and pavement structure, accumulate the frozen single-load damage response over the declared 50-year traffic sequence, apply the identical overlay trigger with boundary-year exclusion, reset accumulated damage after each trigger, and retain the resulting integer event count. Preserve the one-to-one structure identifier; never pool structures or extrapolate to a network.
edges.aggregationRule: Apply the frozen load-to-event accumulation operator separately to each model output on the identical traffic sequence.
edges.scaleReconciliation: Map each single-load response to one 50-year event count for the same pavement structure through the declared accumulation operator; report structure-level results only.

edges.toConstruct: model-indexed road-section baseline overlay event count
edges.spatialAlignment: same one-to-one declared pavement structure and road section
edges.operatorDefinition: Carry each frozen model's integer overlay event count from one pavement structure to its one-to-one declared road-section representation while retaining the model-structure identifier. Do not average models, pool structures, or extrapolate to a network.
edges.aggregationRule: No aggregation; preserve one model by one pavement structure by one road section.
edges.scaleReconciliation: Declare one lane-kilometre road-section view of the same pavement structure and retain the model identifier and 50-year event count unchanged.

edges.operatorDefinition: Evaluate every frozen service-share state with the same overlay rule, subtract the baseline event count from the scenario event count, and retain the signed integer difference for the same section and 50-year horizon.
edges.aggregationRule: Apply the frozen service-share grid and overlay trigger without interpolation beyond the declared scenario points.
edges.scaleReconciliation: Map the declared service fraction to modeled section events, then retain the event count for one lane-kilometre without network extrapolation.

edges.operatorDefinition: For each scenario overlay event, multiply the frozen overlay thickness by the declared lane width, one-kilometre length, and mixture density, convert cubic metres to tonnes, and report tonnes per lane-kilometre per event without RAP, binder, network, or annual extrapolation.
edges.aggregationRule: Multiply frozen thickness, lane width, length, and mixture density per event.
edges.scaleReconciliation: Reduce each 50-year road-section event to one declared lane-kilometre event and report no network or annual extrapolation.

endpoints.label: Gross installed HMA per overlay event

comparisons.decisionRule: Classify a case as materially discrepant only when the absolute symmetric normalized discrepancy exceeds 0.10 and its sign remains stable across every frozen shared-input sensitivity state; otherwise report agreement within tolerance.
comparisons.reportingLevel: Report each vehicle configuration within each pavement structure, followed by a four-structure cluster summary without treating the 12 cells as independent.

comparisons.decisionRule: For each pavement structure, compare the complete ordering of the three frozen vehicle configurations; report exact agreement, ties, or rank reversal without declaring either model correct.
comparisons.reportingLevel: Report configuration rankings within each pavement structure and the count of structures with exact agreement, ties, or reversal.

comparisons.decisionRule: Classify the frozen model structures as decision-disagreeing for a case only when their 50-year overlay event counts differ by at least one event in every reported central sensitivity state.
comparisons.reportingLevel: Report the integer event-count difference by configuration within pavement structure and summarize at the four-structure cluster level.

comparisons.decisionRule: Flag the first frozen service-share state whose scenario count exceeds the baseline by at least one event, while reporting every state and every threshold sensitivity result.
comparisons.reportingLevel: Report signed additional events for one declared road section over the frozen 50-year scenario; do not extrapolate to a network.

quantities.label: Freight service share
quantities.numeratorType: declared freight service from the target configuration
quantities.denominatorDescription: all declared heavy-truck freight service in the scenario
quantities.normalizationJustification: This is a bounded scenario fraction, not a directional comparison between model outputs.

quantities.label: Cross-model fatigue damage ratio discrepancy
quantities.denominatorDescription: arithmetic mean of the two frozen model damage ratios on the same case
quantities.normalizationJustification: A symmetric denominator preserves model exchangeability because neither engineering model is designated as field truth.

quantities.label: Signed cross-model fatigue damage ratio difference
quantities.numeratorType: mechanistic-model damage ratio minus reference-model damage ratio
quantities.denominatorDescription: arithmetic mean of the two frozen model damage ratios on the same case
quantities.normalizationJustification: The symmetric denominator preserves model exchangeability while the frozen subtraction order supplies direction only for sign-stability and ranking reports.

quantities.label: Absolute cross-model overlay event-count disagreement
quantities.numeratorType: absolute difference between the two frozen model overlay event counts
quantities.denominatorDescription: one identical pavement structure, traffic sequence, and 50-year scenario
quantities.normalizationJustification: The quantity is an integer event-count difference and is not normalized.

quantities.label: Signed additional overlay event count
quantities.numeratorType: scenario overlay event count minus baseline overlay event count
quantities.denominatorDescription: one declared road section over the identical 50-year scenario
quantities.normalizationJustification: The quantity is a signed integer event difference and is not normalized.

quantities.label: Gross installed HMA mixture
quantities.normalizationJustification: The accounting quantity is reported per physical event and is not normalized against another model.

datasetRoles.justification: Supplies frozen model inputs and configuration definitions; it is not an outcome validation dataset.
Checks equation and endpoint implementation against published examples but shares definitions and is not independent field validation.

validationPlans.originalUnitDefinition: Twelve pavement-structure by declared-load-configuration cells: four frozen pavement structures crossed with three frozen non-powertrain configuration levels.
validationPlans.independentClusterDefinition: Four pavement structures identified by pavement-structure-id are the independent data-generating clusters.
validationPlans.nestingRule: The three declared load configurations are repeated within every pavement structure and are not counted as independent clusters.
validationPlans.reportingUnitDefinition: Report discrepancies and rankings by configuration within structure; uncertainty summaries resample and report at pavement-structure level.
validationPlans.independenceJustification: The four frozen pavement structures are the only independent comparison clusters.
validationPlans.reportingPrecision: Report the exact 35 cluster-level multisets; do not infer precision from iteration count.
validationPlans.minimumDetectableDifference: No population-level MDD claim with four independent structures.

independentValidation.justification: No independent powertrain-labelled field outcome exists; claims remain cross-model.

datasetRoles.justification: Supplies descriptive interval, thickness, and density context only; it is not used to validate either frozen model.

validationPlans.originalUnitDefinition: The 392 source records are candidate LTPP section observations before deterministic section deduplication.
validationPlans.independentClusterDefinition: Verified unique LTPP sections after deduplication; the count remains zero until the frozen data audit completes.
validationPlans.nestingRule: Repeated records are nested within LTPP section and may not be counted as independent observations.
validationPlans.reportingUnitDefinition: Report section-level descriptive context only after deduplication; make no validation or population-precision claim.
validationPlans.independenceJustification: Repeated records will be deduplicated by LTPP section before any descriptive context count is reported.
validationPlans.reportingPrecision: Descriptive context only; no validation or resampling precision claim.

independentValidation.justification: This plan supplies context and is not presented as validation.

thresholds.criterion: The absolute symmetric normalized discrepancy exceeds 0.10 and the discrepancy sign is stable across every frozen shared-input sensitivity state.
thresholds.basisJustification: The 0.10 symmetric discrepancy is a prespecified reporting convention, not an empirical accuracy or policy threshold; every result is also reported continuously.
thresholds.stabilityRule: The signed mechanistic-minus-reference discrepancy must retain the same nonzero sign in all seven central one-at-a-time states; any zero or reversal is reported as unstable.
thresholds.sensitivityReportingRule: Report the continuous absolute and signed values for all seven states before the threshold classification and never suppress an unstable state.

thresholds.criterion: The absolute integer event-count difference between the two frozen model structures exceeds zero events over the same 50-year case.
thresholds.basisJustification: One integer overlay event is the smallest nonzero difference under the frozen event-count operator and therefore changes the modeled maintenance decision.
thresholds.stabilityRule: Decision disagreement is stable only when the event-count difference remains at least one in every reported central uncertainty state.
thresholds.sensitivityReportingRule: Report all seven central states and label the case unstable if any state crosses the one-event classification boundary.

thresholds.criterion: Within the frozen service-share grid, flag the first scenario whose signed integer overlay-count difference exceeds zero events over 50 years.
thresholds.basisJustification: One event is the smallest integer change produced by the frozen overlay operator and defines the first scenario with an additional modeled intervention.
thresholds.stabilityRule: The first flagged service-share state is stable only when the additional-event classification is unchanged across all nine scenario sensitivity states.
thresholds.sensitivityReportingRule: Report the complete service-share grid under every one-at-a-time scenario state and disclose all threshold crossings or ordering changes.

routes.rationale: Use the current native host public-web search before requesting paid access.
Acquire indispensable licensed full text only after lawful public routes fail.

knownGaps.description: No powertrain-labelled WIM exposure is available, so the project does not claim EV field validation.
No same-project RAP, yield, removal, or ticket data are available, so the quantity remains gross installed HMA only.

uncertaintyParameters.label: Shared pavement layer modulus range
uncertaintyParameters.distributionOrRange: Frozen source-supported low, central, and high modulus states applied identically to both model structures
uncertaintyParameters.applicationPoint: Shared pavement-input preparation before either frozen model is evaluated.
uncertaintyParameters.compositionRule: Replace the central modulus with the source-bound low or high state identically for both model structures; change no other factor or parameter.

uncertaintyParameters.label: Shared pavement layer thickness range
uncertaintyParameters.distributionOrRange: Frozen construction-tolerance states applied identically to both model structures
uncertaintyParameters.applicationPoint: Shared pavement-input preparation before either frozen model is evaluated.
uncertaintyParameters.compositionRule: Replace the central layer thickness with the source-bound low or high state identically for both model structures; change no other factor or parameter.

uncertaintyParameters.label: Vehicle load-factor sensitivity
uncertaintyParameters.distributionOrRange: Frozen low, central, and high load-factor states shared by both model structures and the scenario bridge
uncertaintyParameters.applicationPoint: Immediately after selecting a frozen load-configuration level and before supplying the load input to either model or scenario operator.
uncertaintyParameters.compositionRule: Multiply each level's normalized load factor by the shared source-bound sensitivity multiplier; never replace or relabel the 0.85, 1.00, or 1.15 exposure level.

uncertaintyParameters.label: Baseline maintenance interval sensitivity
uncertaintyParameters.applicationPoint: Baseline event-count initialization for every service-share state.
uncertaintyParameters.compositionRule: Replace only the baseline maintenance interval with the selected source-bound state and recompute event counts without changing service share.

uncertaintyParameters.label: Analysis-horizon sensitivity
uncertaintyParameters.distributionOrRange: Frozen boundary-year inclusion and exclusion states around the 50-year horizon
uncertaintyParameters.applicationPoint: Boundary-year handling in the overlay event-count operator.
uncertaintyParameters.compositionRule: Evaluate the same service-share grid at exactly 49, 50, and 51 years while leaving service-share values unchanged.

uncertaintyParameters.label: Overlay-trigger sensitivity
uncertaintyParameters.distributionOrRange: Frozen low, central, and high trigger states supported by the overlay-rule evidence role
uncertaintyParameters.applicationPoint: Overlay-trigger comparison inside the event accumulation and reset operator.
uncertaintyParameters.compositionRule: Replace only the trigger with the selected source-bound state and recompute counts for every unchanged service-share level.

uncertaintyParameters.label: Overlay thickness range
uncertaintyParameters.applicationPoint: Gross-HMA accounting operator for each modeled overlay event.
uncertaintyParameters.compositionRule: Evaluate each frozen thickness state with every frozen density state without changing event counts.

uncertaintyParameters.label: HMA mixture density range
uncertaintyParameters.applicationPoint: Gross-HMA accounting operator after event volume is computed.
uncertaintyParameters.compositionRule: Multiply event volume by each frozen density state across the full thickness-by-density factorial without changing event counts.

uncertaintyGroups.applicationRule: Run the all-central state and then vary exactly one parameter to its low or high state while holding the other two central; apply identical state values to both frozen model structures and report all seven states.
Run the all-central scenario and then vary exactly one of the four parameters to its low or high state; evaluate the complete service-share grid in every one of the nine states.
Evaluate all nine thickness-by-density combinations and report the full range plus the prespecified central 120 mm by 2.35 t/m3 state.

factors.label: Declared modeled load configuration
factors.applicabilityBoundary: The three levels are generic frozen load cases used only for cross-model comparison. They do not identify propulsion technology, fleet prevalence, adoption, or field exposure.

levels.label: Configuration A
levels.definition: Frozen lower load-factor case evaluated on every pavement structure.

levels.label: Configuration B
levels.definition: Frozen central load-factor case evaluated on every pavement structure.

levels.label: Configuration C
levels.definition: Frozen upper load-factor case evaluated on every pavement structure.

decisionLossMetrics.label: Overlay decision disagreement
decisionLossMetrics.decisionRule: Count a loss when the two frozen models imply different integer overlay event counts for the identical case.
decisionLossMetrics.reportingLevel: Configuration within pavement structure, then four-structure cluster summary.

decisionLossMetrics.label: Configuration ranking disagreement
decisionLossMetrics.decisionRule: Classify exact ordering agreement, tie, or rank reversal across the three declared configurations without designating either model as truth.
decisionLossMetrics.reportingLevel: Pavement structure, followed by counts over four independent structures.

decisionLossMetrics.label: Scenario overlay trigger
decisionLossMetrics.decisionRule: Identify the first frozen service-share state with a positive integer additional event count and disclose threshold instability across all scenario states.
decisionLossMetrics.reportingLevel: One declared road section over the frozen 50-year scenario.
